_note: Positive controls for the literature adapter (design doc §9). Each `ours` is the shorthand a Signal/WHU source list would carry; `assertion` carries a figure the document must contain. HOW THEY WERE CONFIRMED: the identifiers were typed from memory on 2026-09-14 and first admitted by reading the registry heading the gate's own resolve() printed -- a human read, but of the gate's output, and the admission criterion was the gate's ok; that process admitted pmid:31562796 (wrong) until FIGURE removed it. So every one of the twelve was then RE-VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY, outside the package, in the title->identifier direction: an exact-title (or intervention/condition) search on Europe PMC or ClinicalTrials.gov v2 returned the identifier in this set, and the returned title was read. All 12 matched. A control is admitted only after both.

known_good.assertion: BNT162b2 was 95% effective in preventing Covid-19

known_good.assertion: median progression-free survival was 24.8 months with palbociclib-letrozole versus 14.5 months with placebo-letrozole

known_bad.ours: MONALEESA-7 — overall survival with ribociclib in premenopausal advanced breast cancer
known_bad.assertion: estimated overall survival at 42 months was 70.2% with ribociclib
known_bad._why: A PMID typed from memory on 2026-09-14 while assembling this very set. It resolves to 'Nivolumab plus Ipilimumab in Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer'. With 'advanced' and 'cancer' counted as distinctive, HEADING passed; only FIGURE refused it. Kept as the negative control that set the oncology boilerplate.

known_bad.ours: Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children (Wakefield 1998)
known_bad.assertion: Andrew Wakefield was struck off the UK medical register in May 2010.
known_bad._why: The CHRONOLOGY reference negative (ruling of 2026-09-14): a true claim about a 2010 event, linked to the 1998 paper, which cannot contain it. HEADING passes (it is the paper); CHRONOLOGY must refuse on the explicit date.

known_bad.ours: Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children (Wakefield 1998)
known_bad.assertion: Andrew Wakefield was struck off the UK medical register following the General Medical Council findings.
